title: Global Freelance & B2B Lead Radar
description: Choose which kinds of client opportunities to find. The Actor scans Reddit, Hacker News and remote job boards, scores every post with AI and returns only real clients who are hiring.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Which types of freelance work you want leads for.

enumTitles: Video Editing, Shorts/Reels, Motion Graphics, VFX

min_quality_score.title: Minimum quality score
min_quality_score.description: AI quality score from 0 to 100. Higher means a clearer scope, a stated budget and a credible client. 70 and above is recommended.

max_items.title: Maximum number of leads
max_items.description: The run stops once this many qualified leads have been delivered. You are only charged for delivered leads.

custom_keywords.title: Custom keywords (optional)
custom_keywords.description: Only keep posts that mention at least one of these words or phrases, for example: shopify, react native, youtube shorts.

max_age_hours.title: Look back (hours)
max_age_hours.description: Only consider posts published within this many hours.

enumTitles: Remote job boards (RemoteOK, Jobicy, We Work Remotely)
